rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the agricultural implement dragged over fields to break up and level soil.

example.english: The farmer used a harrow to loosen the soil.
example.traditional: 農夫用部耙將啲泥土耙鬆。
example.jyutping: nung4 fu1 jung6 bou6 baa3 zoeng1 di1 nai4 tou2 baa3 sung1
